## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section with tumor called at all four margins [F7] and 3/5 Invasive neighbors.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 98%, Invasive 2% [F1] | Low invasive risk score (2%) |
| Conformal set | InSitu (90% target coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 96th percentile OOD [F6] | Passes QC; near OOD tail |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 InSitu, 3/5 Invasive (40%) [F5] | Closest reference cases are Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Typical score (+0.41 contribution), failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce benign stroma/fat (+0.40 contribution); passed 20/20 spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.39 contribution, caption inconsistent); 18/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Elevated duct-confinement score (-0.18 contribution); 12/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Low pleomorphism score (-0.15 contribution); 18/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (diff +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (diff +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses, and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal stromal invasion exists in high-risk regions 9 (75%) or 2 (74%), matching Invasive neighbor BACH_0138 (87% similarity).
- Severity-3 JPEG compression on this simulated frozen section (96th OOD percentile) masks invasion or distorts margin calls.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 2, 1**: Inspect highest-risk regions (75%, 74%, 51% risk) for stromal invasion, especially region 2.
2. **Regions 5, 6, 11**: Verify tubule architecture versus DCIS; region 11 shows 39% risk and scarce stroma.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Check superior (215 um), inferior (323 um), medial (430 um), and lateral (323 um) margins.
